tagline.en_US: Self-hosted collaborative notes and knowledge base with pages, inline databases, and SQLite storage.

description.en_US: Notara is an open-source collaborative notes and knowledge base application. It features a block editor that supports paragraphs, headings, code, toggles, callouts, and file attachments, alongside inline databases with table and board views. It enables real-time collaboration with shared editing and provides full-text search across titles and block content.
